basic_info.description: Discover the charm & elegance of this exquisite 4+ bd/3 ba home w/beautiful views & abundant natural light perched on the edge of Glen Park & Noe Valley. The welcoming grand foyer sets the tone for the home's graceful interiors that flawlessly blend classic charm & modern luxury. The centerpiece of the home is a modern kitchen with brand-new appliances, quartz countertops, a breakfast bar, and abundant cabinet space. It seamlessly connects to the dining area, family room, and a spacious deck overlooking a large backyard - an ideal setting for entertaining guests w/ease. The residence features 4 spacious bds upstairs, the perfect setup for privacy & comfort. The lux primary bd suite w/views of downtown is a true retreat, featuring a large, newly remodeled spa-like bathroom w/stunning shower and an expansive walk-in closet. The convenience of an upstairs laundry area, another full bath, 3 additional bedrooms & office w/adjacent deck complete the upper floor. The home also boasts a large garage w/internal access + storage, another full bath on the main floor + bonus room off the backyardperfect for a home gym, artist studio, or another office. Close to vibrant Noe Valley + EZ access to 280 & a short walk to the Church St Muni - experience the best of San Francisco living!
